cause: The workflow's shipment-source constructs the shipping request with reservation_id taken from the original input order_id rather than from the reservation returned by inventory. The authored workflow therefore schedules order-17, while the inventory result supplies a different reservation_id; run then detects the mismatch and fails instead of returning the required shipment.
evidence: The workflow source docstring says it reserves inventory and schedules that exact reservation for shipment, but shipment-source uses (get input "order_id") for reservation_id.

The captured generated inventory source reads (return (inventory/reserve {"item" "lamp" "order_id" "order-17"})), while the generated shipping source reads (return (shipping/schedule {"destination" "north-depot" "reservation_id" "order-17"})).
The captured workflow failure value is {"kind" "reservation-routing-mismatch"}, after both mission evaluations returned.
